body:
PR #2796 (TASK-1981 F6/F7 follow-up to merged #2778) is ready for review at 65a0c9c6e2.
It makes init and upgrade/release capture the publication snapshot under the store writer lock, and adds regression tests.
CI is green: Build plus all 7 lanes. The only red check is merge-hold-gate, which is the expected supervised hold (aida:merge-hold) and needs your clearance after review.
Round 1 failed the git auto-maintenance ratchet. I fixed it by adding the -c guard pair to the writer-test git closure.
Local check-ci-fast never ran: it sat in the cargo slot queue for 2.5h behind advisor builds. CI is the gate.
subject: READY: #2796 TASK-1981 F6/F7 green at 65a0c9c6e2
